name: m3-baseline-2026-10-30
note: Milestone 3 checkpoint (~31.8M params, BPE vocab 2048, block 512, 6000 iters, ~19.2MB RFC+NIST corpus). Measured locally on CPU over the 91-task suite + held-out intrinsic. Enforced metrics are tokenizer-independent; perplexity/top-k are recorded for reference. Supersedes m2.json as the regression floor for the M3 lineage.
